data.body:
Fix landed in worktree + before/after churn evidence (AC5).

Change: PeerConfirmationStore.record() is now change-gated (builds a candidate record from material fields + set-once first_confirmed_at; returns without touching _records or _dirty when it equals the stored record), and the volatile per-pass confirmed_pass / confirmed_at fields are removed. The now-vestigial pass_id parameter is dropped from record(), confirm_from_snapshot(), backfill_from_managed_refs() and their two call sites (reconcile._confirm_peer_links, apply_handlers._make_link_confirm). first_confirmed_at and all identity/decision fields are retained, so confirmation stays relation-scoped, monotonic, additive and fail-open.

Before/after evidence — isolated two-pass runtime probe over ONE unchanged authoritative link (identical inputs, wall clock advanced between passes), hashing the on-disk sidecar each pass:
  BEFORE fix: pass1=7d849e3…, pass2=58fba08… -> DISTINCT -> 2 unique blobs, a full 2nd-file rewrite for zero material change.
  AFTER fix:  pass1=e353435…, pass2=e353435… -> IDENTICAL -> 1 blob, zero new packed bytes on the unchanged pass.
So a converged pass now writes the sidecar zero times (save() early-returns on not-dirty), eliminating the per-pass blob/pack growth this bug reported.

Migration/compat: one-time and bounded. The first time each pre-existing on-disk record is re-observed post-upgrade, its stored shape is rewritten once (dropping confirmed_pass/confirmed_at); after every live link has been observed once, unchanged passes converge to zero writes. The sidecar is fail-open, so a mixed-shape file mid-migration is read without error. No production consumer read the removed fields (repo-wide search; only tests asserted them), so nothing downstream breaks.

Regression tests (RED before fix, GREEN after): test_two_passes_over_unchanged_snapshot_do_not_rewrite_the_sidecar (byte-compares the artifact across two complete persistence passes — AC4), test_reconfirming_unchanged_link_leaves_the_store_not_dirty, and test_reconfirmation_is_idempotent_and_does_not_rewrite. Existing store/backfill/snapshot suites updated to the new contract; assert the volatile fields are absent. make lint + make typecheck + full tests/unit/rebar_reconciler suite green.
